Remarks

A meld is a Block that does not need any additional tiles to be a useful part of a hand, compared to a Wait, which is incomplete, and would become a meld given additional tiles.

The Tiles that make up the meld.

Remarks

It's not possible to construct a concrete version of this class as it's abstract, but it must be mentioned that even if you could, it is preferred to use IBlock static functions such as GetPossible(IEnumerable<Tile>), or the GetFirstLevelMelds(IEnumerable<Tile>) static helper function in this class to ensure proper semantic meanings.

Methods

GetFirstLevelMelds(IEnumerable<Tile>)

Returns all possible first-level melds from a collection of Tiles.

public static IEnumerable<MadeBlockContext> GetFirstLevelMelds(IEnumerable<Tile> tiles)

Parameters

tiles IEnumerable<Tile>

The Tiles to use to create MadeBlockContexts of first-level melds.

Returns

IEnumerable<MadeBlockContext>

An IEnumerable<T> of MadeBlockContexts of first-level melds that can be created from tiles.

Remarks

A "first-level" meld is a single Chow, Pung, or Kong that can be made from tiles. Note that this does not include Pairs. Instead, GetFirstLevelWaits(IEnumerable<Tile>) will generate first-level PairWaits, which can be explicitly cast to Pairs.
